description: When it started becoming very clear on March 14th, 2020 that restaurants were going to have to shut down I felt completely panicked. I needed answers and guidance, and my first thought was to call Robyn. For days to come, she would send me updated information as soon as she could, send me grant and loan applications, and come by to check on me and my restaurant. I truly felt more secure knowing that she was in my corner.

title: Molly | Robyn For WI
